title: Thick sphere under internal pressure (axisymmetric, quarter meridian section)
description:
Thick-walled steel sphere (spherical pressure vessel) under internal pressure, axisymmetric model. Coordinates: x = r (distance from the axis of revolution, axis at x = 0), y = z (along the axis). By symmetry about the equatorial plane only the quarter meridian section in x >= 0, y >= 0 is modelled (STEP: a planar face in the xy-plane).
Geometry: quarter annulus centred on the origin, inner radius a = 0.1 m, outer radius b = 0.2 m. Edges: equator y = 0 from (a, 0) to (b, 0); outer arc of radius b; edge on the axis x = 0 from (0, b) to (0, a); inner arc of radius a.
Material: linear elastic, E = 2e+11 Pa, nu = 0.3.
Loads: uniform internal pressure p = 1e+08 Pa (100 MPa) on the inner arc. The outer surface is traction free.
Supports: equatorial symmetry plane y = 0 (u_z = 0); the edge x = 0 lies on the axis of revolution (u_r = 0 there).
Report (SI units):
  ur_bore       radial displacement at the bore on the equator, u_r at (a, 0) [m]
  uz_pole       axial displacement at the inner pole, u_z at (0, a) [m]
  hoop_bore     hoop (circumferential) stress sigma_theta at (a, 0) [Pa]
  vm_max        maximum von Mises stress [Pa]
  strain_energy total strain energy of the modelled half sphere (full 360 degrees) [J]
